summary: A sharp tech-led rotation is splitting markets: equal-weight indexes are holding near flat while cap-weighted SPY and Nasdaq track for weekly losses, as money exits mega-caps and flows into broader sectors. A hawkish Fed has driven the dollar to a new 2026 high, pressuring gold and commodity prices.
tweet: Tech rout splits the tape — Nasdaq and SPY down on the week while equal-weight holds as a hawkish Fed-fueled dollar hits 2026 highs and crypto bleeds from ETF outflows.
